name: m0saic-jewelry-templates
description: Templates for Mosaic for Jewelry, the m0saic Desktop solution for jewelers. Each release is a signed bundle that Desktop installs on its own.

scripts.build: node tools/gen-template-catalog.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/copy-assets.mjs && node dist/gen-template-manifest.js && node tools/check-registry.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:contract && npm run check:deps

//dependencies: The @m0saic/* substrate is on npm. The 0.x ranges (types, platform,
template-utils) track the m0saic CLI line; the language packages (dsl,
dsl-stdlib) version on their own. AUTHOR MODE (build / test / lint) is
`npm install && npm run verify` — no monorepo checkout, no file: links.
dist/, template-manifest.json and template-catalog.json ARE committed:
a clone loads with no build step, and `npm run bundle` packs exactly the
committed build into the release Mosaic Desktop installs. Rebuild before
every commit; the ranges move to ^0.4.0 when the 0.4.0 packages publish.
